productConcept.name: Seedkeep
productConcept.description: A living botanical archive preserving heirloom seed varieties and botanical wisdom for future generations through a reciprocal steward network.
productConcept.rationale: The pressed-fern design system is built on Cormorant Garamond italic display at 90px, EB Garamond body, warm ivory #fcf7f1 background, and ink-reveal clip-path animations. The concept_by_image.md explicitly establishes 'Seedkeep: A Heritage Seed Library & Botanical Nursery' as the foundational concept. The editorial botanical journal aesthetic — unhurried motion, manuscript typography, warm earth tones — is a perfect vehicle for an archival seed library. The landing page interprets it as a membership-based stewardship platform rather than a retail nursery.
